description: Mostnik, the troll-like spirit of an old bridge, a squat mossy creature made of grey weathered planks and frayed ropes, a crooked face with a big nose and long hairy ears, holding out one big hand for a toll coin and pushing forward with the other, red guelder rose berries tangled in its moss, menacing, standing on both feet, full body, three-quarter view, the creature alone, no bridge, no ground, no background, the whole figure inside the picture
